detail: Fees for managing property you do not own are business income; income from renting out property you own is reported as rental income on Schedule E.

detail: Gains from trading on Kalshi are taxable and included in AGI/MAGI regardless of their federal tax character. value: 60% long-term / 40% short-term capital gain; year-end mark-to-market; Form 6781
detail: Contracts that qualify as section 1256 contracts are marked to market at year-end and taxed 60% as long-term and 40% as short-term capital gain regardless of holding period.

item: Whether Kalshi event contracts qualify as section 1256 contracts
detail: No IRS ruling or published guidance classifies Kalshi event contracts as section 1256 contracts; the tax character (section 1256 vs. capital asset vs. other) is unsettled and Kalshi itself takes no position. See Flagged for Review.

item: Earned vs. unearned income for MAGI
detail: For Medi-Cal and premium tax credits, household MAGI includes both earned income (wages, net self-employment) and unearned income (interest, dividends, capital gains, net rental, retirement).

value: Offset gains; up to $3,000 per year against other income; carryforward
detail: If capital losses (including trading losses) exceed capital gains, up to $3,000 per year is deductible against other income with the remainder carried forward - this lowers AGI and therefore MAGI in loss years.

value: $580 per month from any source (before taxes) satisfies the requirement for a month
detail: The DHCS member outreach letter lists having an income from any source of at least $580 (before taxes) in any month since the last renewal as a way to meet the rule; people with changing hours or seasonal jobs can average $580 per month over 6 months.

item: Whose income counts for the $580 test
detail: Not specified in DHCS member materials. Secondary analyses of the CMS rule report that CMS uses the individual's MAGI-based income for their MAGI-based household, and that the $580 can be earned or unearned income and can be deemed from other household members - confirm with the county Medi-Cal office.
